title: Transposon mapping using flanking sequence exponential anchored \(FLEA) PCR
protocol: Prepare the PCR mixture in GeneMate UltraFlux tubes by mixing 1 µL of 5 μM biotinylated primer, 4 μL genomic DNA, and 45 µL Invitrogen Platinum high fidelity SuperMix.
Carry out annealing and linear extension using the following conditions:
95°C for 5 min followed by 30 cycles of 95 °C (45 seconds), 62 °C (45 seconds), and 72 °C (3 minutes).
Incubate at 72 °C for 10 min, then cool to 4 °C until the next step.
Transfer PCR reaction products into Amicon Ultra 0.5 100K filter tubes, add 200 μL of nuclease-free water.
Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 10 minutes at room temperature; retain 42 μL concentrated purified sample.
Invert the column in clean tubes and centrifuge at 1,000 g for 2 min.
Place the tubes onto DynaMag 96 magnetic holder.
Remove supernatant.
Add 20 μL kilobaseBINDER kit Binding solution.
Place tube onto DynaMag 96.
Remove solution.
Resuspend magnetic beads in 10 μL Binding solution.
Add 5 μL of isolated PCR product from the previous step.
Add 5 μL of nuclease-free water.
Shake tube at room temperature for 3 hours.
Place tube onto DynaMag 96.
Remove supernatant.
Add 40 µL of kilobaseBINDER kit Washing solution.
Place tube onto DynaMag 96.
Remove 40 μL Washing solution.
Add 40 µL of nuclease-free water.
Remove 40 μL water.
Add 20 µL of 0.1M NaOH.
Shake for 30 min at 37°C.
Place tube onto DynaMag 96.
Remove NaOH.
Add 40 μL nuclease-free water.
Place tube on DynaMag 96.
Remove water.
Prepare the PCR buffer mixture by mixing:
Mix 15 µL nuclease-free water with other components.
Add 1 µL of 10 mM dNTP (0.5 mM) to the tube with streptavidin beads.
Mix by pipetting.
Incubate at 95°C for 1 minute.
Decrease temperature to 37 °C over 10 minutes.
Centrifuge to collect any condensate.
Add 1 µL of T7 DNA polymerase.
Incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Place tube on DynaMag 96 and remove supernatant.
Add 40 μL of water.
Place tube on DynaMag 96 and remove supernatant.
Repeat washing step four times.
Prepare the PCR mixture: Add 1 µL of 25 µM Transposon1 primer, 1 μL of 25 μM Exponential primer, and 45 µL of Invitrogen Platinum High Fidelity SuperMix.
Add 48 μL of PCR mixture to the beads and mix by pipetting.
Carry out PCR using the following conditions: 95 °C for 5 minutes.
35 cycles of: 95 °C for 45 seconds, 62 °C for 45 seconds, 72°C for 3 minutes.
1x 72 °C for 10 minutes.
Use PureLink PCR Purification Kit to purify PCR product amplicons.
Elute in 50 μL nuclease-free water.
Prepare PCR reaction mixture using 1 μl of 25 μM Transposon 2 primer, 1 µl of 25 μM Exponential primer, and 45 μl Invitrogen Platinum High Fidelity SuperMix.
Add 3 µl of purified PCR product to 47 μL of PCR mixture in GeneMate UltraFlux tubes.

Carry out PCR using the following conditions: 95 °C for 5 minutes, followed by 35 cycles of 95 °C for 45 seconds, 62 °C for 45 seconds, and 72 °C for 3 minutes, then a final extension at 72 °C for 10 minutes.
Purify PCR product.
